Yi Sang's eyes slowly opened.

Their lives are so easily light, so easily recoverable.
这些人的生命无足轻重，轻易便能死而复生。

I see... You have reversed my death as you always do.
是啊……这次你也一如既往地回调了时间。

A flash of light burst out of the Golden Bough right as it pierced his chest, blinding everyone for a moment...
金枝在贯穿他的胸口时，迸发出的耀眼金光暂时遮蔽了所有人的视野……

And Dongbaek had disappeared in the meantime.
在那期间，冬柏已经不见踪影。

The smiles the people in the photograph made at each other were nowhere to be seen now.
照片中相视而笑的人们现在已不知所踪，

And Dongrang cast his eyes into emptiness, reviewing the situation we got into.
只有东朗仿佛是为了回味目前的状况一般望着虚空。

dataList.content:
It's not our responsibility to compensate for any injuries, is it? If this has left psychological scars, you are free to demand compensation, but please know that the procedures will be rather complex...
我方没有需要进行人身伤害赔偿的责任，如果有心理上的问题的话，也可以提出申请，不过那个处理手续可相当繁琐，还请充分考虑……

No, my problem is with how you're describing this whole--
不是，所以说现在你说的这些话……

Leave the matter there.
罢了。

I do not feel an ounce of pain. So you have no need to pursue this matter further.
已经不再疼痛了。所以就此结束吧。

When I turn the clock, every consequence is reversed.
只要回拨时钟，一切就会复原。

Torn clothing, bloodied stains, even the smallest scars are undone.
不论是被撕碎的衣物，还是血迹，甚至连最微小的伤痕都不会留下。

But that doesn't make the cause of those damages something that never happened.
但是这并不等于一切都不曾发生过。

Which is why I have to ask.
正因为如此，我问道。

<Are you sure you're okay, Yi Sang?>
<李箱，你确定真的没事吗？>

Yi Sang shut down my last attempt to inquire with a simple "Yes", so I couldn't try again until now...
之前李箱用“没错”之类的回答应付过去了，所以我没能进一步的追问……

But that man named Gubo had no problem raising his weapon against Yi Sang while claiming to be his compatriot.
可那个名为仇甫的人，不也是以朋友相称，却将他连同罪人们一起给砍了吗。

I see, you must have been rather curious.
看来，你一定对此颇为好奇。

This time, he didn't seem to have any intent to dodge my question.
这次，他似乎没有要敷衍了事的想法。

I was once part of an organization named the League of Nine. Gubo, Dongrang, and Dongbaek, the one who stabbed my chest. Those faces you have seen were members of it as well, manager.
曾经，我身处名为九人会的团体之中。仇甫，东朗，刺穿我胸膛的冬柏。经理，正是与你所见识过的那几人一起。

However, it disbanded and scattered one day. Each of us was flown away into our own path.
但是有一天，它支离破碎，分崩离析。于是人们各奔前程，四处飞散。

That was all there was to it.
仅此而已。

Aw, what~ Feels like your story's missing a ton of details, y'know?
什么啊~与其说是仅此而已，倒不如说省略掉了很多内容吧？

You broke up 'cause things happened and now you're pointing knives at each other~ Like, is that it?
发生了这样那样的事情分开之后，又因为某些缘故变成了拔刀相向的关系~是这样的吗？

Or maybe they were never friends after all.
或者有可能他们从一开始就不是朋友。

It was no more than a moment. I believe my testimony to be apt for a time as transient as that.
仅仅是瞬间而已。正因为是瞬间，故而以此表达非常贴切。

He started talking a lot. He hasn't turned into a chatterbox just yet, but I had the feeling that he'd soon become more talkative.
他的话变多了。不对，虽然目前还没有那么啰嗦，但可以感觉到他接下来就要变啰嗦了。

I was reminded of Faust mentioning once that he was never really the quiet sort.
不知何时……浮士德说他原本并不寡言的话，从我脑海中闪过。

<Are you really sure you're okay, Yi Sang?>
<李箱，你真的确定你没事吗？>

I have always been okay.
我向来是没事的。

If that was his true nature, then this might not be a bad thing.
如果说他原本就是如此，那说不定现在真的没事。

Still, my feelings say that I should care for his well-being.
但是，我的直觉仍然告诉我担心他的安危才是正确之举。

<From your recent memory, umm... Have you had any particularly happy or painful moments or something like that?>
<所以说，你最近有没有……最为高兴或者难过的瞬间之类的？>

...You are devoting an unusual degree of attention to me today. While it does not please me... I will give you an answer since your demeanor is quite unlike the usual.
……唯独今天你对我颇为关心。虽然这并不令人欣喜……但既然你的举止与往常相异，我将对此作答。

If I were to choose one, the happiest occasion in recent memory would be... when we held an illuminators' conference.
硬要说的话，最近最为高兴的事情是……举办朗术会的时候。

And the most hopeless one would be...
而最为绝望的瞬间……

At the forest where I first met you.
是在第一次与你相遇的那片森林。

The very moment my life resumed when I was certain that it had ended there.
在那里，我那毋庸置疑已经逝去的生命，再度重生的瞬间。

Another such moment is now. I am once again realizing that this regeneration is ever so flawless, unchanging.
以及现在。意识到这种复生是如此完美无缺，一成不变的此刻。

I hope that sates your curiosity.
如何，这算是作答了吗？

Now, should we not be on our way? I see a long road ahead of us.
现在，我们该上路了吧？前路漫漫。

As he walked ahead...
突然间……

I could almost see it.
好像只有我看得到。

Although the wound was perfectly erased, there was still...
虽然被完美的弥合，但又被完美的洞穿……

A hole in his chest, wide open with no signs of mending.
不论怎么看，都看不出曾被弥合过的，那开在他那胸膛上的窟窿。
